Name: PANDAmoniumPaint's Portraits
Author: Llaera
Description:
This mod includes portraits for all Stardew Valley villagers, up to and including update 1.5.

I primarily created this mod for myself, partly as a challenge for myself, and just to add my own little flair to the Stardew Valley world. I've decided to make it available for anyone that would potentially enjoy using the portraits as well. I won't claim that they are perfect by any means, but maybe they'll give you a little spark of joy when you use them too!

In general, these portraits are my interpretation of the villagers based off of their sprites, so please pardon any differences from the originals.

Created with GIMP.

[b]Please download via the "Manual" option to install.
[/b]
UPDATE 1.0.1 - I've added an Update Key to the manifest.json, so hopefully it'll be easier to monitor if I make any updates to the mod!
UPDATE 1.0.2 - Added missing portraits and made minor tweaks. See the changelog for full details!
